A11-1.reason: Compound shell guard rejected A10-1 before A11 append, but unconditional detached launch checked the identical A10 source under A11-1. This is A10 attempt2, not a new unit. All later commands use set -e.

A11-2.reason: First actual A11 declaration check; A11-1 checked A10 bytes and is counted as A10 attempt2.

V16.reason: Valid original-source check; exact owner-approved comment-only correction after37 checks. No declaration/type/body byte changed. Keep record, use V38 for final source.

rawPassMeaning: passedCount preserves the runner outcome; qualifiedPassedCount excludes explicitly invalidated validation invocations without rewriting their exact records.

guardChecksPassed: fresh PASS with own Building line

matchingSourceCommitsMeaning: Baseline plus target-changing commits in (start,end], matched by SHA256; validation repeats can match the same source commit. Empty for rejected/uncommitted sources.
packageFreshMeaning: Inherited runner marks package fresh on successful seeded --build (no forced source rebuild); source checks require target Building line.
